court.name: L.B. Nagar Fast Track Special Court for Rape and PoCSO Cases

summary: In November 2024, one person was accused of the child sexual offence in Hyderabad, Telangana. A weapon was used or a threat was made. The accused is recorded as a repeat offender. The accused was convicted and sentenced to 20 years in prison. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Child sexual offence — Hyderabad (2024) — convicted, 20 years
